object.attr: stakeholder: an object ID names one object for good, because links on other branches, history, Compare and issued PDFs refer to it. The next number has to survive a squashed or rewritten history, so it is kept with the document rather than worked out from history. A manifest without it counts as 0, so documents from before it still load. Decided on 2026-11-06 (open question Q7).
object.description: The manifest shall hold the document's next object number as the next-object-number attribute of its document element.
